shell_shrine.doc: The Shell Shrine trial (M2-FP-16; vertical_slice.md B07, haluna.md §3; logic in ShellShrineTrial). Water from the spring pours into `source_into`. Each basin pours out of one lip, which faces outlets[rotation]: another basin, `goal` (the inner pool), `drain` (the side pool's sluice) or `spill` (a floor grate, lost). An interaction turns a basin one step (90°) clockwise; rotation counts 0..steps-1. While the traced water reaches the goal, the inner pool fills over fill_sec and, once full, the chamber door floods open (it stays open). The first time water reaches the drain, the side pool empties for good and the net-float charm can be picked up. hint_scene plays once after hint_idle_sec with no turn. solution_moves is the band the shortest solution must sit in (checked by tools/tests/test_shell_shrine_trial.py). layout: greybox placement in metres for the level (x east, z south; the entrance is west, the door east).
